div.head: Wer 2
div.ab: Gif man ofslægen weorðe, gylde hine man swa he geboren sy.
Gyf man ofslægen weorðe, gylde hine man swa he boren sy.
Si homo occidatur, sicut natalis eius erit, persoluatur.
Wenn ein Mensch getödtet wird, werde er entgolten, je wie [hoch] er geboren ist.
If a person is killed, let him be paid for according to how [high] he was born.
If someone is killed, let him be paid for to whatever station he be born.
div.note: U: translator probably Wormald, The Making of English Law (named in the original spreadsheet’s sub-header rows): check; Liebermann compares II Em 1.
